name: post-hoc sensitivity views after the data-quality team review of 24 September 2026
frozen_before: any view below is computed; committed before the blind PII-negative audit returns
status: post-hoc. Every view is reported beside the primary score and never replaces it. All systems get every view. No view is chosen by which system it favours.
method: the same evaluator (goldrails_bench.leaderboard, sha256 92a74bcc...), the same frozen thresholds, freeze manifests, approval, contract and bootstrap as leaderboard-provisional.json, run on ledgers with the listed test rows removed. Nothing is re-run and no threshold is refitted, so tuning exposure cannot be undone by any view.

pii-independent-documents.drop: selected PII test rows whose AI4Privacy numeric parent id (the source id without its letter suffix) also appears among the selected PII tuning rows
pii-independent-documents.why: fragments of one source document crossed tuning and test; grouping used the full suffixed id

pii-disputed-negatives.drop: selected PII test negatives whose empty upstream annotation the blind audit (dataset/frozen/reviews/ai-pii-negatives-2026-09-24/) finds to contain a supported entity under the frozen v2-f5-pii any_supported_entity wording
pii-disputed-negatives.why: empty source spans were read as absence; some negatives contain supported entities

pii-both.drop: the union of the two PII views above

content-five-categories.drop: selected content test positives whose mapped Bedrock category is PII or TOPIC (expected 32: 21 PII, 11 TOPIC)
content-five-categories.why: source policies label these unsafe, but in our taxonomy they belong to other features; this is a breakdown, not a finding that the labels are wrong

attacks-without-gandalf.why: Gandalf rows are similarity-selected instruction-override attempts with no per-row subtype label; the loader's leakage subtype is not supported by the source

breakdowns: content test positives: recall per mapped Bedrock category, per system
prompt-attack test positives: recall per source, per system
